Text: WHILE a points transaction is Pending, WHEN the POS sends a return for its purchase, the loyalty service shall reverse the transaction without changing the member's redeemable balance.
WHILE a points transaction is Posted, WHEN the POS sends a return for its purchase, the loyalty service shall deduct the transaction's points from the member's redeemable balance.
WHEN a support agent submits an adjustment, the loyalty service shall require a reason code.
Rationale: Adjustments must be explainable in audits.

Text: IF an adjustment exceeds 5,000 points, THEN the loyalty service shall hold it until a second support agent approves it.
